batch_rationale: The 32 labels cover basic nitrogen compounds, H-bond donors, multifunctional esters, neutral carbonyls, halogenated aromatics, and low-polarity scaffolds. Most selections use one row per structure. Two solvent contrasts and one matched loading pair receive additional labels because they test effects that isolated structures cannot resolve. Predictions and quantile spans guide coverage only; none is treated as a measured outcome or calibrated uncertainty.
batch_strategy: Prioritize chemically varied structures, with limited matched experiments on basic nitrogen, H-bond donation, and loading. Include both ordinary and less-represented PE/EA conditions without selecting for large predicted V1 or V2.

feedback_interpretation: This is round zero: the latest digest contains no new measurements or acquisition residuals to interpret. The listed initial observations are controls, not evidence of a current model failure. In particular, the measured hydroxy bromobenzaldehyde and fluorinated benzaldehyde differ in more than H-bond donation, so their endpoints do not isolate an HBD effect.
